{{Quote|''Marvelous'', Dr. Aphra. On top of everything else I asked you to acquire, you were able to obtain this ''rare coral'' from Alderaan's ''Polar Sea''. Virtually nonexistent since the planet's destruction.|Ronen Tagge, to Chelli Lona Aphra|<ref name="Aphra 2" />}}
The '''Polar Sea''' was a [[Ocean|sea]] located on<ref name="Aphra 2" /> the [[Core Worlds]]<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]''</ref> [[planet]] [[Alderaan]]. A [[Unidentified Alderaanian coral|type]] of [[coral]] could be found in the sea that the [[House of Tagge]] scion [[Ronen Tagge]] stated was rare.<ref name="Aphra 2" /> In [[1 BBY]],<ref name="Destruction" /> Alderaan and its Polar Sea were destroyed<ref name="Aphra 2" /> by the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] [[superweapon]],<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> which left the coral virtually nonexistent.<ref name="Aphra 2" />

Between 1 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]] and [[3 ABY]],<ref name="Date">[[Doctor Aphra (2020) 2|''Doctor Aphra'' (2020) 2]]—which ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of to [[3 ABY]]—establishes [[Ronen Tagge]] hired [[Chelli Lona Aphra]] to acquire artifacts between the [[destruction of Alderaan]] and the [[Star Wars comic books|issue's]] events. As ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas: Updated Edition]]'' dates [[Alderaan]]'s destruction to [[1 BBY]], he must have hired her between 1 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]] and 3 ABY.</ref> Tagge hired the rogue [[archaeologist]] [[Doctor]] [[Chelli Lona Aphra]] to acquire a number of artifacts which he planned to destroy. While she obtained the artifacts for Tagge, Aphra also acquired some of the coral, which thrilled him, noting it had been virtually nonexistent due to Alderaan's destruction. After the [[Archaeology|archaeologist]] was paid by Tagge, she [[Thief|stole]] the artifacts back from him.<ref name="Aphra 2" /> In 3 ABY,<ref name="Date" /> Aphra informed her [[Aphra's crew|crew]] about the incident with the coral from Alderaan's Polar Sea after Tagge told the archaeologist's crewmate—[[Professor]] [[Eustacia Okka]]—to give Aphra his regards.<ref name="Aphra 2" />

==Behind the scenes==
In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], Alderaan's Polar Sea was mentioned in flashbacks in the [[Doctor Aphra (2020) 2|second issue]] of the [[2020]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] series [[Star Wars: Doctor Aphra (2020)|''Star Wars: Doctor Aphra'']]. The issue was written by [[Alyssa Wong]] and published by [[Marvel Comics]]<ref name="Aphra 2" /> on [[July 22]], 2020.<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/82204/star_wars_doctor_aphra_2020_2|text=Star Wars: Doctor Aphra (2020) #2}}</ref>

The [[polar sea]] originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where it was first mentioned in ''[[The Illustrated Star Wars Universe]]'', a [[1995]] reference book written by [[Kevin J. Anderson]].<ref name="Illustrated Star Wars Universe">''[[The Illustrated Star Wars Universe]]''</ref> The [[Ocean/Legends|sea]] was first depicted in ''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]'', a [[2003]] sourcebook published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] for use in the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Coruscant and the Core Worlds">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref>
